title.zh: 授权 Culion 麻风病聚居区的合格选民在地方选举中投票选举巴拉望省民选省级官员的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Qualified Electors of the Culion Leper Colony to Vote in Local Elections for the Elective Provincial Officials of the Province of Palawan
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Qualified Electors of the Culion Leper Colony to Vote in Local Elections for the Elective Provincial Officials of the Province of Palawan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6659_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The qualified electors of the Culion Leper Colony in the Province of Palawan, who were registered as such in the May 11, 1987 national election as well as those who may qualify and register in accordance with the law in future elections, are hereby authorized to vote for the elective provincial officials of the Province of Palawan.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
